text: The authors report that a probing method that reaches 99.3% AuROC at detecting flawed code from Sleeper Agents (Hubinger et al., 2024) performs no better than chance on their RLHF-trained model, and conclude that detecting intentionally induced deception (I-Sophistry) is not a good benchmark for methods meant to detect unintended misleading behaviour.
title: Wen et al.: probes that catch Hubinger et al.'s sleeper agents fail on RLHF-induced misleading
